svg.title: Switzerland study map
svg.desc: Representative places for orientation. These dots are not legal wine-area boundaries. Named towns locate the surrounding study area; the country window may omit distant territory. 1: Valais near Sion; 2: Vaud: Lavaux; 3: Geneva vineyards; 4: Three Lakes near Neuchâtel; 5: Ticino near Bellinzona; 6: Lake Zurich vineyards; 7: Bern; 8: Basel; 9: Luzern; 10: Biel; 11: Chur; 12: Saint Gallen

g.title: 4 · Three Lakes near Neuchâtel: representative location

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine
